propositions: The rebar-implement skill currently enforces a model-tiering gradient (strong/standard/cheap tier table) that adds complexity for minimal token savings on wide epics only and should be removed.
Phase 0 preflight currently rejects any ticket without children, even if it is a story or task with a recorded file impact that is already an executable code leaf.
The skill must recognize two executable shapes: tickets with children (tree execution) and childless story/task with non-empty file impact (single leaf execution).
The held-out discipline of a separate implementer subagent must be preserved in Phase 4 despite removal of tiering language.
All references to model tiering (strong/standard/cheap tiers, Tier escalation ladder) must be stripped from Phase 3, 4a, 4d, and 4e-bis, with 4e-bis rewritten as tier-free Escalation guidance.
Frontmatter description, Phase 0 heading, Phase 2 callout, and Reporting stop line must be made consistent with both the gradient removal and childless-leaf support.
